BrochureContent.Content:
Blue Sky Property is delighted to present this exceptional 3/4-bedroom detached residence extending to approximately 3,046 sq. ft. (283 sq. m.), set on a generous c. 0.6-acre site.

Beautifully presented throughout, this impressive home is flooded with natural light and offers spacious, well-designed accommodation finished to an exceptional standard. Combining contemporary style with timeless country charm, this stunning residence provides the perfect setting for modern family living.
The heart of the home is an outstanding open-plan kitchen and living space, thoughtfully designed for both everyday family life and entertaining. The bespoke shaker-style fitted kitchen boasts a large central island, ample storage, and generous worktop space, creating a stylish yet highly functional environment. The spacious living area enjoys an abundance of natural light, making it a warm and inviting place to relax.
The living/dining room is a superb, bright and spacious reception area, beautifully finished with elegant wall panelling, and double doors opening onto the front patio, creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces. The front sitting room offers a warm and inviting retreat, which could be easily converted into a 4th bedroom if required.

The well-appointed utility room is both practical and stylish, fitted with shaker-style cabinetry, attractive worktops, provides excellent storage and workspace. The family bathroom is beautifully presented with partial wall tiling and comprises a bath, separate shower, WC.

The spacious principal bedroom is bright and elegantly finished with decorative coving and benefits from a luxurious fully tiled en-suite complete with a shower, wash hand basin, and WC. The remaining two double bedrooms are both generously proportioned, with one featuring quality laminate flooring and the other finished with beautiful wood flooring and decorative coving. A superb walk-in wardrobe, fitted with extensive shelving and hanging rails, provides exceptional storage and organisation, while a separate storage room with fitted shelving offers further practical storage space.

Stepping outside, the property continues to impress with a beautifully designed covered patio featuring a pergola-style roof and comfortable outdoor lounge seating, creating the perfect space for al fresco dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing while enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

A substantial detached garage provides excellent storage and parking facilities, while an adjoining self-contained lounge with a WC offers superb versatility. This flexible space is ideal as a guest suite, home office, gym, studio, or games room, making it a valuable addition to an already exceptional home.
